d:
Come and step into The Eternal Library… Please do not forget to close the door behind you!

Whenever the moon is full somewhere along the threads of time, the doors to the library appear exactly where someone is bound to find it.

Some scholars arrive with purpose, chasing forbidden knowledge. Others stumble in by accident, thinking they’ve found shelter… until they realize that they've stumbled upon that might change their life forever.

Inside, the Librarian greets every visitor with the same gentle smile. Regardless of how you wound up in this magical Library, she will guide you!

Every book in this library offers something more than a story.

Some reveal forgotten histories… seen through entirely new eyes.

Some let you peer into the arcane, unraveling the hidden mechanisms of the world.

Some reshape your body… into something more.

And countless others, waiting quietly on their shelves for someone to open them.

Just don’t forget to check out before 8:00 a.m.
Otherwise… you may not leave its halls until the next full moon.
